texte.À qualifier le système — génératif ou no: To qualifying the system — generative or not —, to selecting which of the twelve risks apply, and to declaring which of the # suggested actions of §# of AI #-# are met. Six of the twelve risks are not cybersecurity matters: CBRN, dangerous content, environmental footprint, bias, intellectual property, obscene content.
texte.À qualifier qui vous êtes au regard de l: To qualifying who you are under article # of Regulation (EU) #/#, then to declaring the regulatory compliance strategy of §#: its five components, and the approach chosen for each of the seven essential requirements of Chapter III Section #. It is the document that neither ISO # nor ISO/IEC # asks for, and the one a notified body opens first.

To be compared with the estimated gain.
texte.À réexaminer à chaque changement de modè: To be re-examined at each change of business model: it is the consideration, not the licence, that brings it down.
texte.À répondre avant tout le reste à la ques: To answer, before everything else, the question on which everything else depends: what are you, within the meaning of the CRA? The Regulation does not look at your business or your company name, it looks at what you do with the product. Two ordinary commercial acts change the role without changing the business — putting your name on a product you resell, and making a substantial modification to a product already on the market.
texte.À répondre à la question que pose tout d: To answering the question every certificate holder asks: « I have ISO #, or ISO/IEC # — what am I missing? » The document's two correspondence tables are read backwards for that: what counts is not what matches, it is the small number of rows that match nothing.
texte.À répondre à la question qui commande to: To answer the question that governs everything else, and it is NOT the NIS # one. The twenty types of financial entities in Article #(#), points (a) to (t), are all in scope, without gradation: there is no equivalent of “essential or important”. What varies is the thickness of the obligations, and that is decided in Article #, where five categories escape Articles # to #.

To answer the question that governs everything else. Qualification is not an honours ranking: it is a supervisory regime. An essential entity is subject to inspections, REGULAR audits and scans without any incident being necessary (Article #); an important entity is inspected only where there is evidence of non-compliance (Article #). And Article #(#), reserved for essential entities, makes it possible to temporarily ban the chief executive from exercising managerial functions.
texte.À répondre à la seule question du règlem: To answer the only question in the Regulation that changes your budget: by what procedure does this product demonstrate its conformity? Internal control, which you sign yourself, or a notified body — several months and a queue that has only existed since June #. Declare your products, choose their class with regard to Annexes III and IV displayed alongside, and the procedure follows.
texte.À répondre, paragraphe par paragraphe, a: To answering, paragraph by paragraph, the requirements of YOUR role. Each question carries the number and the title of the paragraph it rests on, what it serves to avoid, and the trap the firm meets in the field on that point.
texte.À savoir ce qu’un système de management: To know what a certified management system ALREADY documents among the articles of Delegated Regulation (EU) #/#, and above all what it does not document. That is the difference between a twelve-month programme and a twenty-four-month one, and it can be costed article by article.
texte.À savoir si un prestataire de services T: To know whether an ICT third-party service provider can be designated as critical, and what designation entails. The delegated act of # February # splits the appraisal in two: a stage # of thresholds — ten per cent of the number AND of the assets of a category, a G-SII or three other O-SIIs —, and a stage # of appraisal.
texte.À situer ce que vous achetez. ISO # est: To place what you are buying. ISO # is the only one of the four references in this space that issues a certificate: the GDPR, NIS # and the CRA are law, you comply with them and nobody hands you an attestation. A # certificate can be shown to a client, a public buyer, an insurer — it is a commercial asset, not just a cost.
texte.À sortir l'analyse de risque du statut d: To take risk analysis out of tick-box status. In the Directive, it is measure (a) among ten. Objective # turns it into four distinct requirements: risk-based governance carried by the chief executive with allocated resources; every system covered, on five named inputs; residual risks explicitly accepted and an action plan in which each action has a deadline and an owner; a review at least every three years.
texte.À séparer deux choses qu’on confond tout: To separate two things that are confused all the time: what CARRIES OVER from one framework to another, and what NEVER SUBSTITUTES. The three impact assessments — the one in clauses # and # of the standard, the fundamental rights impact assessment of Article # of the AI Act, the data protection impact assessment of Article # of the GDPR — concern the same object and are not the same thing.
texte.À trancher si un incident doit être noti: To decide whether an incident must be notified, then to say when. Delegated Regulation (EU) #/# sets a CONJUNCTION: critical services affected AND either successful malicious access on its own or two other thresholds together. Criticality is a gate, not a seventh threshold.
texte.À voir où vous en êtes du cadre NIST, fo: To see where you stand on the NIST framework, function by function, without ever adding up the four. GOVERN is the foundation: MAP, MEASURE and MANAGE presuppose it. A respectable score on treatment with governance at zero does not describe an organisation that manages its risks — it describes an organisation putting out fires.
texte.À vérifier qu’aucune des dix défaillance: To check that none of the ten most frequent failure modes has been forgotten. It is neither a standard nor a certifiable framework: you do not comply with it, you use it as a checklist. Each risk says why it persists, which is worth more than an instruction.
texte.À vérifier qu’un contrat de services TIC: To check that an ICT services contract carries the clauses the Regulation imposes. Nine in paragraph # for any arrangement; six more in paragraph # as soon as the service supports a critical or important function — “in addition to the elements referred to in paragraph #”, so a cumulation of fifteen, not a replacement.
